description: The bar chart illustrates the GPU memory usage in gigabytes (GB) for different fine-tuning methods applied to language models. The horizontal axis lists the methods: Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, LORA, QLoRA, and Ours. The vertical axis represents the GPU memory usage, ranging from 0 to 60 GB. The Full FT method uses the most memory, approximately 60 GB, while the Ours method uses the least, around 20 GB. The MTL-FT method uses about 40 GB, TAG and LORA both use around 20 GB, and QLoRA uses approximately 10 GB. The bars are colored in shades of orange, except for the Ours method, which is green.
